name: Runner Extras - Date Virtual Table Window
brief: Issue #2309: the Date system virtual table (2000000007) is computed on demand on the service tier and spans years 1 to 9999, which cannot be materialised whole. The runner materialises a window and widens it on demand; this suite pins the two runner-specific halves of that: a closed filter bound outside the default window is materialised on demand, and a request past the row cap throws RunnerOutOfScopeException instead of answering with fewer rows.
description: What the Date table itself answers — which weekday a date is, which ISO week a Monday starts, when a leap February ends, that Period End is a closing date — is plain BC behaviour and is covered upstream in the al-language corpus (Test Date Virtual Table, codeunit 60983). This suite deliberately asserts none of that. It asserts only what exists because this is the runner: that the materialised window is not a silent truncation. The default window is 1900-01-01 to 2099-12-31 and the default row cap is 500,000 (AL_RUNNER_DATE_WINDOW_MIN_YEAR / _MAX_YEAR / _MAX_ROWS), so a filter naming 1850 is outside the window but well inside the cap, and a filter spanning year 1200 to year 9998 is far past it.
